actions: flex the MTP joints while extending the IP joints of toes 2-5

functional_compartments.name: Lumbrical 1 (medial)
functional_compartments.function_note: Medial-plantar-nerve innervated -- distinct from lumbricals 2-4, the same radial/ulnar-style split pattern seen in the hand's lumbricals.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

functional_compartments.name: Lumbricals 2-4 (lateral)
functional_compartments.function_note: Lateral-plantar-nerve innervated; unlike the hand where the split is 2 median/2 ulnar, the foot's split is 1 medial-plantar/3 lateral-plantar.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
